related_questions.question: Is a NAAT test the same as a PCR test?
related_questions.snippet: Most of us know the term “PCR test” because of testing for COVID-19. But it's been used in medicine for a long time and has many other uses. Any test that uses a polymerase chain reaction technique is a PCR test. PCR is a type of nucleic acid amplification test (NAAT).
